Perfect — Garuda Dragonized is actually one of the best distros for this (super lightweight KDE, no bloat, Arch rolling updates). Your i3 + 16 GB will love ZeroClaw even more here than on heavier setups.
Easiest install on Garuda (one command, ~2–3 minutes total)
Open a terminal and run this official one-liner (it auto-detects Arch/Garuda, installs base-devel + Rust if needed, then builds the tiny binary):
Bashcurl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zeroclaw-labs/zeroclaw/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
After it finishes:
Bashzeroclaw onboard          # interactive wizard (super quick)
zeroclaw migrate openclaw # (optional but recommended — imports all your channels, skills, memory, configs)
zeroclaw daemon           # starts the agent in background
That’s it. The final binary is ~8.8 MB, runs on <5 MB RAM idle, and starts in <10 ms. Your laptop fans will probably stay off.
